saints.name: St. Finnbarr of Cork
saints.title: Bishop
saints.shortBlurb: The hermit of the lake at Gougane Barra who founded the monastery and school from which the city of Cork arose…
biography: Finnbarr (Barra) was an early Irish monk and hermit who withdrew to a lonely island on a lake among the hills at the place now called Gougane Barra, the source of the river Lee. Disciples gathered to him, and he later moved downriver to found a monastery and school on the marshy ground where the city of Cork afterward grew.
Honoured as first bishop and patron of Cork, he was renowned for his learning and his monks, and died about 623. His cult has been kept in the south of Ireland from ancient times.
saints.knownFor: Founding the monastery and school that became the city of Cork.
